full_page.content:
1947, October 24
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
POST CARD
Bles'd be God in all His designs!
Feast of St. Raphael Archangel. 1947.
God bless you Mrs. Mauer.
I hope this finds things brightening. I have just enrolled Richard for this intention. We'll pray for you all - that our dear Lord guide and guard. Best regards and God's blessing - including your . Stella. Praised be Jesus Christ!
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
Original card in possession of : Mrs. George R. Farrell 1120 Roslyn Rd. Grosse Pointe Woods, MI. 48236
